name: OnDocumentReopen
caption: When a document is reopened (interactive)

configuration.description: Document table: Sales Header 36 or Purchase Header 38 (the releasable documents). Extensions can register more tables. Known supported values: 36, 38. Extensions can register more, so other values are not rejected by this reference.
Run only in interactive client sessions.
Maximum run time. The editor replaces values <= 0 with 30.
Field filters on the document header: [{ "fieldNo": <integer>, "filter": "<BC filter expression>" }]. Applied literally (max 250 chars, no placeholders).

outputs.name: Rec
outputs.when: always; tableNo = configuration.tableNo (declared as 'value' when tableNo is 0). Carries the status from before the reopen.

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be > 0. Hard stop at publish.
rules.message: Pick the document table the flow should watch.

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be a supported reopenable document table. Hard stop at publish; also shown live in the canvas status line.
rules.message: Table %1 is not one of the supported reopenable document tables.

rules.check: timeoutSec should be > 0 (the editor writes 30 for values <= 0).
Any error in the flow (e.g. an Error step) prevents the reopen and shows the flow's message.

notes: Fires on the MANUAL reopen of a Sales or Purchase document, including documents with status Pending Approval. Previews never fire it.

Synchronous and atomic: runs inline in the user's transaction, without commits. An error prevents the reopen. A Set document field values step adjusts the header; with 'Skip standard processing' the header is saved with the flow's values and Business Central's own reopen (Status := Open) is skipped.

Pending Approval: Business Central normally refuses to reopen such a document. When a reopen flow ran for it, that block is lifted - unless Business Central's own approval workflow still has open approval entries for the document.

Business Central version dependency: for Purchase documents on BC24-BC27 the flow runs one event later (after Business Central's Pending Approval check), so on those versions a Pending Approval purchase document cannot be reopened through the flow. Sales documents are not affected.
A Confirm dialog step can ask the user; the reopen waits for the answer.
Re-entrancy guard: a reopen that the running flow itself performs does not start the flow again.
No recurring Job Queue entry; the registration is keyed by tableNo.
Picker filter: Set document field values is offered. Respond to Webhook, Return SubFlow Output, Return PDF, Set report file name and Prevent page close are hidden.
